title: CARLA-native low-sun glare mechanism and severity roles after Route151 visual bake-off

authorization_basis.user_instruction: 以后无需我审计，预实验可以直接开始
authorization_basis.interpretation: A bounded, outcome-blind visual preexperiment may freeze corruption mechanism and severity roles before any closed-loop result is read.
does_not_authorize: adapter checkpoint selection with native glare
a collision, TTC, uncertainty, planning, or generalization claim

mechanism_decision.reason: The native renderer preserves pose-level temporal coherence and avoids the rectangular white-patch boundary. The observed effect is primarily natural exposure, bloom, and atmospheric veiling rather than a strong localized ghost-flare effect.

medium_primary_development.use: primary development severity; selected without collision or TTC outcomes

heavy_stress.use: prespecified stress severity; report separately from the primary severity

next_gate.required_action: Run the frozen medium primary severity on one independent route not used for glare tuning; heavy may run as a separately labelled stress condition.
next_gate.selection_policy: The confirmation route must be chosen without consulting native-glare closed-loop outcomes.
minimum_evidence_before_expansion: temporal glare effect remains coherent under a different route geometry
the corruption produces a measurable ORION task or safety-proxy degradation without requiring collision
no adapter training or checkpoint selection uses either held-out native-glare route

claim_boundary: This freezes a visual corruption mechanism and two prespecified severity roles only. It does not establish that glare causes ORION failure, that an uncertainty signal detects glare, or that uncertainty-aware behavior improves safety.
